scope: Explicit read-only Android V4 DC reload; no automatic change to login, restore, registration or call behavior

flow: NetworkHelperImpl.getDCs invokes Network.sendV4 with null input
NetworkImpl.sendV4 uses getJsonInput with both V5/V6 flags disabled
MessangerInput2.getJsonObject emits raw auth, numeric api_version 4, client and method getDCs
Only getJsonObjectV6 applies EncryptionHelper.encodeChars to auth
primaryAndroidEvidence.discoveryStorage: DataCenterManager caches GetDcsOutput and chooses default_api_urls using apiCounter; no sign-in response endpoint persistence or auth-to-DC map was identified

primaryWebEvidence.bootstrap: DC discovery runs before stored auth registration at bootstrap
primaryWebEvidence.laterReload: The generic unencrypted transport can include existing auth during a later getDcs request
primaryWebEvidence.registrationRequired: NOT_REGISTERED invokes the device-registration event; it is not treated as a DC failover result

rootControlledLiveProbe.scope: Retained Android test credentials; metadata reported by the root executor, without account identifiers or URLs
rootControlledLiveProbe.interpretation: None of the three returned official DCs accepted the protected session read. Routing alone did not restore this retained session in the tested set; the cause of the later authentication failure remains unproven. No further registration was attempted.

statusAndAnonymousDiscoveryParity.androidStatusInterpretation: In each method the DEX if-ne compares the response status to ERROR_ACTION before the respective NOT_REGISTERED and INVALID_AUTH callback. A different status does not trigger those state actions.
statusAndAnonymousDiscoveryParity.androidDiscoveryVersion: MessangerInput2.getJsonObject reads api_version at code-unit offset 16, loads integer 4 at 18 and calls JSONObject.put(String,int) at 19. Android anonymous discovery now emits numeric 4. The Web string and existing explicit Android credentialed discovery remain unchanged.
statusAndAnonymousDiscoveryParity.webStatusSource: handleCustomErrors starts at byte 1769195 of main-es2015.6421623571994c9dd619.js. ERROR_ACTION INVALID_AUTH triggers invalidAuth, ERROR_GENERIC INVALID_AUTH triggers accessDenied, and NOT_REGISTERED triggers the Web registration event except for registerDevice/logout. The Lab exposes a typed error and never registers automatically from this mapping.
statusAndAnonymousDiscoveryParity.protectedEndpointComparison: NetworkHelperImpl.getUserInfo, getMySessions and registerDevice all call the same default Network.sendV5OrV6 overload at code-unit offset 16. NetworkImpl calls getSendObservable at offset 6, whose offset 87 calls the common send path. No separate registration-specific route was found in this chain.
statusAndAnonymousDiscoveryParity.webBootstrapOrder: ngDoBootstrap starts getDcs without awaiting it, then app initialization reads and installs stored auth, starts a service-base request and the socket, and checks local device registration. The ordinary registerDevice and protected reads use the common DC response path. This order does not establish a mandatory socket or separate service-base handshake for registerDevice.
statusAndAnonymousDiscoveryParity.localMapping: Unknown top-level INVALID_AUTH statuses and Android NOT_REGISTERED without ERROR_ACTION retain the recognized service detail as service_rejected. The known Web and Android invalid-auth variants retain their existing typed results.
statusAndAnonymousDiscoveryParity.limitation: This is request and error-state parity. It does not establish why retained sessions were rejected, change any saved session, enable retries or reinterpret historical probes that did not retain the top-level status. No new live request was made.

privacy: No account IDs, credentials, discovered URLs, phone numbers, RSA keys or private responses
